notes.title: 1.0.0.1 - 1.0.1.4 Hot Fixes
notes.notes: [p]From 1.0.0.1 - 1.0.1.4 have seen various reports of glitches and fatal bugs that will lead to game crash. We first would like to apologize for the inconvenience.[/p][p][/p][p]With the nastiest of them fixed and some unpleasant minor ones unsolved and we are working closely to tackle them in the next few days. But for now, let's look at what has been done over the last two days and nights:[/p][p][/p][p]==============================================================[/p][p]					Version 1.0.0.1 - 1.0.1.4[/p][p]==============================================================[/p][p][/p][p][b]---- Game Play ----[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- Balanced store price by increasing price for all levels of main/sub weapons: before the player can get to higher weapon level too quick, which makes the middle-later game experience less engaging.[/p][p]- Balanced shotgun bullet number and attack cd as it was way too over powred.[/p][p][/p][p][b]---- Bugs ----[/b][/p][p][/p][p]-- major --[/p][p]- Fixed various fatal bugs that will cause game crash during the play.[/p][p]- Fixed various nasty bugs that will cause the game shut down.[/p][p]- fixed a bug that will cause player stuck at run clear scene after clearing a run and starting a new run right away.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that cause 9 achievements unfunctioning.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that will cause game crash when displaying overall accumulated amount of diamond exceeding 15000 at game over/run finish scene.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that will cause crash when playing as construction vessel after defeating puffer fish boss.[/p][p]-- minor --[/p][p]- "Banker" trait unfunctional bug fixed. [/p][p]- Fixed a bug that some of the huge turtles do not drop diamond at death.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that will cause game not continue if puffer fish drift away not being hurt.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that will cause music volumn issue, the music volume will vanish after clearing a run.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that will cause game crash when player is defeated during a run and not click button to exit to main menu. [/p][p]- Fixed a bug that will cause the revive wing effect (from trait "cross") blinking all the time after triggered.[/p][p]- Fixed a but that will cause right side girl change when switching language at pause menu.[/p][p][/p][p][b]---- Graphics & UI ----[/b][/p][p][/p][p]- Big diamond was way too big, now it is in a reasonable size.[/p][p]- Improved certain traits' visuals.[/p][p]- Show "NEXT CHARACTER" sign above character profile at run finish/game over screen.[/p][p]- Fixed some localization issue (mis-spelling mostly).[/p][p][/p][p]==============================================================[/p][p][/p][p]We hope this current 1.0.1.4 version is more stable. So please if you encounter anything that is not seem to be alright, please feel no hesitate to contact us by leaving a comment here, @PotatoCat or DM at Discord channel or sending me a email, I will make response ASAP.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you very much for your bug reports! I will see you in the next patch note soon![/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]The Potato Cat[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/11838759954810ba992382ee14029e4eb003075f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Hopeless Sea Release + Update Roadmap!!!
notes.notes: [p][url="https://discord.gg/z5JAyEN2MQ" style="button"]Join Our Discord[/url][/p][p][b]Welcome![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Ladys and gentlemen, guys and girls! I am so exceted to welcome you to the 1.0 Hopeless Sea release announcement (hip hip ːsteamhappyːhuray!)[/p][p][/p][p]This Potato Cat as usual, I will introduce you the finally here 1.0 Hopeless Sea and what's next for Hopeless Sea future updates.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b][i]1.0 Release[/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][p]First of first, let's talk about what we have prepared for 1.0, as we have said before, either here or other social media, the full version of HS has...[/p][p]\[[i]11 waves[/i] and [i]４ bosses[/i] (at wave 3, 6, 9 and 11), [i]5 unique characters[/i], plus [i]4 main weapons[/i] and [i]3 sub  weapons[/i] ][/p][p]It inherited the key elements of Hopeless Sea Demo 0.7 (3 waves + 1 boss) and expanded to a longer adventure. Clearing a run for a STG veteran will likely take 25 - 30 minutes to complete at normal difficutly.[/p][list][*][p][b][i]Lore[/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Many of you lovely people have asked me about if there is any lore behind this game and the answer is clearly YES! There is, indeed, some story happened behind all this catastrophe, we are working closely to bring it to you in the next patch if not one afterwards.[/p][p]To be honest, the idea of having story background for this game is from players! Have been asked about "what is behind" "why city is under water" millions of times, So thanks to you, I now have to give a formal and rational answer.[/p][p]So basically, everything happens after 20 years from now, extreme heat melts all the remaining glacier causing massive sea level rise, all the big coastal cities like LA, NY, Shanghai, Rio... you name it, are all gone under the water. The world map has therefore reformed dramatically, which I will bring to you in the future later. As to the crazy sea monsters, they are caused by pollution and radioactive particales, which make them extremely dangerous and killing-frenzy.[/p][list][*][p][i][b]Roadmap to 1.1[/b][/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]-bugs-[/b][/p][p]The top top priority is, of course, dealing with bugs! There are many of them hiden in the codes and I will pledge you to help me deal with it XD, so if you please, when you see them, simplely send it to me wherever you can find me![/p][p][b]-fragment story-[/b][/p][p]You will be able to find some notes/diary after defeating enemys and read them in teh store, they will help you to construct a broad scene of the background during that time. There will also be some self-talky dialogues of each characters, so you may found more interesting background of their own.[/p][p][b]-more bosses-[/b][/p][p]There will be at least 3 more alternative bosses to be designed for wave 3, 6, 9. Some of them are drawn months before, but not complete yet in terms of timing.[/p][p] Here is a sneaky peak view for two of the bosses:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/951c27031821aae10bbef2056c74e5c95d550b3a.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/c3f121450e2f389ab90db8360c3b72ec97b4ba59.gif"][/img][/p][p][i](Flounder & manta ray)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]-weapon case-[/b][/p][p]This will probably be of roguelike lovers looking for, so for now if you kill an orange ship, it will drop diamonds, but instead, the original idea is to have them drop weapon crates in very early demos. Like what we had back in 1990s, eating a crate will either increase weapon power immediately if timing is right or switch to another weapon if wrong (Raiden series, Demon Star etc.). So here you will need ask the mechanic (store girl) to help you swtich weapon when you need to, which I believe this method will be much more pleasant than those old day methods (personally, I don't really mind the Raiden way but let me know which one you prefer in the comments).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/9cf3c35c54f59d6c2a5f6d9bf5739d7fafd46e1c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/202e7daba95fca673838d10eb37b474684ef7da5.png"][/img][/p][p][i](weapon crates examples)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]-more weapons, more traits, more power ups-[/b][/p][p]We are aware that to keep players engaged, game play must be engaging, so in STGs the enemys needs to be deadly, and players want to be even more deadlier than them. So there will be some ways to help players to build up their armory - charging melee weapons, penetrating laser beams etc. We will see what we will bring to this game. Oh, by the way, the privateer girl is associated with smuggler deal so she will likely become a in-game merchant later :)[/p][p][/p][p][b]-2-5 more characters-[/b][/p][p]There can be more characters and ships, we wanted to make 2 more characters/ship (or maybe a seaplane) at least as free update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]-endless mode & arena mode?-[/b][/p][p]This have to be in a later patches like 1.2 or even 1.3. We wanted to have a steam ranking system for endless mode and  boss by boss fight arena mode. We can talk about that more later.[/p][p][/p][p][b]-Hopeless Sea 2??-[/b][/p][p]We are really considering a universe of Hopeless Sea and make a sequel for Hopeless Sea themed in rebuilding human society and cities (floating cities? duono :D), and that can be a STG + buildy genre mixture. But that will be a while later hehe.[/p][list][*][p][b][i]Bundles[/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/04d186cfc4e4191d84152b95662a9d40b11c2340.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/cf0b8ed0489ccdd22d4bcaabdc8bfa600a90f457.png"][/img][/p][p]Last but no least, we bundled up with two other indie devs here, [u]Divine Orders[/u] (STG + RPG elements) and [u]Genome Guardian[/u] (vampire suvivor-like), they both very unique and fun to play games so if you fancy, why not buy them together with Hopeless Sea for better pricing?[/p][p][/p][p]We have already updated 7 patches till this is written, they are all for the annoying fatal bugs, we apologize for the inconvenience caused by our bug, our bad, we will work harder to eliminate them.[/p][p]There is still a long way for Hopeless Sea, so let us know what you want to see in the future below. Thanks for reading![/p][p][/p][p]I will see you in the next dev log![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/z5JAyEN2MQ" style="button"]Join Our Discord[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p]The Potato Cat[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/f0703048d3ae28eb6bebdb8171b9b3fd24cd3bc5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Hopeless Sea Releasing Date Announcing During OTK Games Expo + Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hi there,

We have good new to share with you:

Hopeless Sea is joining this year's OTK Games Expo at the Pre-show event! OTK Games Expo is one of the largest indie showcase fest in the world therefore we are so blessed (they usually only pick 50 from swamp of titles so...)!

Anyway, we are approaching the biggest milestone of Hopeless Sea, the full release. One thing is certain that it will happen in June, 2025! We will soon post another event reminder for expo's time and link.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/1d94359d16bdeed135193b2105b8cf69f915e669.png[/img]

==============================================================
					Demo Version 0.7.0.7 - 0.7.0.8 
==============================================================
---- Game Play ----
- From now on, all available weapons can be upgraded to level 4, the max level without need to worry about bugs.
- Elevate negative effect in the game, now squid enemy can fire bullets that "blind" the player for short period of time.
- Enhanced trait Gas Mask effect that reduce negative effect time from 50% tp 75%.
- Rebalance of machine gun's power and upgrades.
- Sharks now pause a very short while before releasing bullet, giving players more time to react.

---- Bugs ----
- Fixed bug that will cause player failed from entering next wave from wave 2.
- Fixed a bug that will cause duo screen and TATE switching unfunctional in option menu and in-game pause menu.

---- Graphics & UI ----
- Enhanced enemy "squeeze" effect while hurt.
- Various store visual upgrades including UI and UX improvements:
	- Mary (store girl) now slowly moves up and down for better visual.
	- Bigger dialogue frame.
	- Selection box animation.
	- Unaffordable items is shaded in gray the same as unavaiable items.
	- Show number of cash spent while purchasing items in the store.
	- Pressing confirm button will bring icon down-right a little.
	- Simplified store button function indication UI.
	- It is now holding leaving button for a short while to enter next wave needed than before.
- Lowered primary weapon bullets' brightness to make them more distinctive from secondary weapon bullets.

All is the latest patch note update of Hopeless Sea demo. As we are working closely to the final release. Please stay tuned!

Please keep reporting bugs! Thank you!

-- Potato Cat

notes.title: Demo 0.7.0.6 Available Now!
notes.notes:
How are you guys doing out there! Long time no see, Wish you are all well!

This is Potato Cat, Welcome!

Good news, as you may have noted, a few months ago we switched release status from “Coming Soon” to “2025”. Yes, it is 99.9% that Hopeless Sea will be finished and delivered to you before the end of year because we have confidence in our development pace and quality. More of that, we are trying hard to get it done before the end of season i.e. full release the game before the end of June. With that being said, sxxx might happen and nobody can tell what will come out tomorrow, so let’s keep the “2025” here for now.

Regarding demo version 0.7, we have brought some significant changes towards game play: rebalanced difficulty curve, weapon balancing, bigger enemies, crispy enemy hitting effects etc. and, of course, more fixed bugs. You may find details down below here:

==============================================================
					Demo Version 0.7.0.1 onward
==============================================================

---- Major Updates ----
- More Random Enemy Spawn Pattern: 
	enemy spawn order is now totally randomized, from now on player will encounter more unpredictable enemy spawn order.
- Floating difficulty: 
	in game difficulty changes according to time elapsed depending on Difficulty player choose at start of a run. The means of adopting floating difficulty is to rebalance game difficulty when enemy spawn order is randomized.
- Increased all characters' ship speed for better maneuver experience (yes, increased again..).	
- All enemy bullets speed reduced, make it easier for players to maneuver/ doge enemy bullets.
- At the mean time, player movement speed are increased a little bit for the exact same reason as above.
- Dead zone of gamepads are now reduced to minimal level for better maneuver experience.


---- Minor Updates ----

- Fixed a bug that prevents system showing which wave player is currently in from wave 1.
- Transport ships (blue enemy ships going downwards carried tons of gems) will now deal no melee damage to players, as they are kind of friendly civilian ship.
- Fixed a font issue that causes text display pixelized problem, which makes text deformed and hard to read.
- Added more visual effects of enemies.
- Rationalize player initial weapon level starting with level 1 instead of level 0 (except characters/hulls that allow bigger initial levels ).
- Extended keyboard control, now using "WASD+JK" works the same as "direction keys + ZX"
- Bomb is unfunctional to enemies
- Fixed a bug that will cause player enter another wave while clicking "Next Wave" multiple times.
- Fixed a bug that will cause game stuck at store page when clicking "Next Wave" button multiple times at store.
- Fixed a bug that will keep the player traits while starting a new run after abort current.
- Fixed a bug that will cause game crash or malfuntion when quiting the current run at trait/store.
- Fixed a bug that the the first 3 to-pick traits are always the same ones.
- Fixed some bugs relate to weapon upgrade information
- Fixed a button label issue that can potentially misguides player.

==============================================================
					Demo Version 0.7.0.6 
==============================================================
---- Game Play ----
- Added gamepad vibration effect.
- Increase torpedo damage.
- Optimize turning speed of homing missile.
- Machine gun fire rate increase dramaticallyfor better performance.
- Replace bridges by safe zone, players entering next wave by touching safe zone for a short period of time.
- Strengthen Wrench trait effect and reduce cooldown from 60s to 45s recover 1 hp.
- Assault boat now have +2 max hp at start

---- Bugs ----
- Fixed a bug that traits selected from previous run inherited to future runs.
- Fixed a bug that traits will be kept for the next run after aborting a run from pause menu.
- Fixed a bug that will stop spawning enemies and cause game difficulty off-balance.
- Fixed a bug that enemy bullets do not disappear after hitting player.
- Repaired a bug that buying armour upgrade increases hp but max hp does not.

---- Graphics & UI ----

- Changed supply ships to orange as player hitting will cause hp loss.
- Added "squeeze" effect that when enemies are hurt, their size will be slightly changed for 
- All player boats' profile outline now coloured in white for better visibility.
- Increased size of atomic bomb shell size for better visibility.
- Switched atomic bomb explosion effect colour from orange to blue to keep colour consistancy.
- Reduced player bullet brightness in order to have better hierarchical distinction with much more powerful player bombs.
- Fixed a display demo finish font display bug.


So there it is, pretty much everything is covered here, possibly the last demo of all demos. Thanks for reading! Now it’s time for you to try the newest demo and see how it goes.

Remember to join the discord for latest news and don’t forget to report bugs anyway you can! If you have any ideas and thoughts, I’m open minded, find me in the Discord channel here:
-------------------------------------------------

notes.title: Hopeless Sea demo coming to Steam Next Fest 24 (PDT 10am)!!!
notes.notes:
It's been a month or so since last time demo has been available, this time, we will bring major upgrade demo version to the public with various improved elements ready for you to explore!

We hope you have a good time here and don't forget to report bugs!

Change log:

==============================================================
					Demo Version 0.6.4.1
==============================================================

---- Major Updates ----

- Extended room width by 1/3 from 360 to 480 pix, i.e. window ratio from 360*640 to 480*640 for better experience (more room for maneuver).
- All enemies that can deal collision damage now coloured in orange in order to be visually outstanding, yes, orange stuff is dangerous in most cases.
- Reduce all item prices in store.
- Faster enemy spawn speed for better experience.
- Reduce time of single wave from ~120 to 80s.
- Each wave will see more enemies to spawn than previous version.
- From now, player setting in the menu (e.g. sound volume, language, TATE etc.) will now be saved as a local .txt file before exit.
	(note: player settting will be saved in a file called "gamesetting.txt" in game's root location, this method requires further testing so if you encounter any bug please send it to the dev anyway you can.)
- Fixed a common bug that will cause game shut down unpredictably after loadig the splash screen.


---- Minor Updates ----

- Added black-and-white blender after player death.
- Added new transit gate asset.
- Added names and profession description of characters, also rationalized submarine commander's costume.
- Fixed a bug that will cause game not to abort while clicking abort button multi times.
- New enemy death effect - added debris.
- Store system upgrade with better UI layout.
- Iceburgs do not drop diamonds any more as they are considered as a kind of obstacles.
- Various localization updates.
- Low hp effect - when player hp less than 2, the screen will draw
- Fixed a bug that may cause multi players boats exist at the same time.
- Fixed a bug that causes sound switch malfunction at in-game pause menu.

notes.title: What's Next? Hopeless Sea Dev Log
notes.notes:
Hi

Hopeless Sea's demo has now been played by a bunch of dedicated players and many of them gave us invaluable feedback towards bugs and gameplay suggestion. Thank you all for doing that!

Now, we found it is time for us to settle down and fix them. We have set the demo to invisible to new players, so if you have already added to your inventory, don't worry you can still access if you like.

Next time we want to bring some big changes to the game play, as well as usual bug fixes. Wanting this game to be more "modern shmup", meaning more powerful player, powerful enemy, fast-paced game, bullet hell and simplified player upgrade route.

With all this being done with certainly take us a bit, but we shall see you in the next patch note.

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year! Be well!

The Potato Cat

notes.title: Hopeless Sea joining PixElated Festival on 29th July! And what to come next...
notes.notes:
Hello steamhappy: dear community, we are thrilled to announce that we are joining this year's PixElated festival on 29th July! Yes, we did it! Finally our effort has been acknowledged by featured curators, hence we want to together share you news and what is coming next.

[h1] New poster[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/219f5f425b940e7993f5674d667e22fe868908c2.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/fc07c425e99414f8c10b2776961eec2765b111d6.png[/img]

New posters, do you prefer the lady to the left with her hat on or not?

[h1]New character design[/h1]

\[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/b801b27e91dc4d87e55b9dd6f77765d40ebfbf89.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/7fbb5cdc04a24696808576dc48553d73f0eac256.png[/img]

Back to the good old days of STG golden era, pixel anime girls and boys are often protagonists. No matter what we are piloting, (star ships, fighters, robots) we are playing those girls and boys. And yes we all love those , don't we? So here we go, we would like to introduce you our first two girls (names undecided, recommendations welcome). What we can confirm is they are navy veterans capable at sea affairs and operate guns and missile. Fair not, they are ready to cut through the hopeless sea together with you.

[h1]New boats[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872665/ba5d18e62df1ba57f5f74c1006b819e62c12eb25.png[/img]

There are two girls, so there must be two boats to play? Yes, and more, we have four for now! They are patrol boat, submarine, biplane (apparently it's not a "boat") and aircraft carrier. They are very different in many ways, for instance, the aircraft carrier shoots bullet-shooting drones and moves quite slowly, pretty much like a floating fortress, and submarine is capable of shooting torpedoes without limit but other boats cannot, it also can duck into the water and doge enemy bullets. More of the features can be found in the game. In the future we really want to bring more boats to enrich play experience, but at current stage our high priority are the demo characters.

[h1]DEMO[/h1]

We are working days and nights to tackle the bugs and refining the first chapter to deliver to you the best quality, once we are done with all the stuff (hopefully before the end of September), we will release a demo on Steam and itch.io for you. So, please be patient, we are on the way.

So, that is pretty much all the stuff to cover with right now.

If you want to know more about this game, us or anything else you are interested, why don't you simply leave a comment below or simply join our discord group and catch us their? Don't forget to click follow and stay tuned.

Thanks @Brave at Night for organizing this event, let us celebrate together pixel art games! I will see you next time!

The Potato Cat
